hook: How to follow up with HR *without sounding desperate*

slides.title: Wait 5-7 working days
slides.body: If they gave you a date, wait one day past it.

slides.title: Body: thank, remind, ask
slides.body: "Thank you for the interview for [Role]. I'm still very interested. Could you share an update on next steps?"

slides.title: One follow-up, then move on
slides.body: Keep applying meanwhile. Silence isn't always a no.

caption:
